label: PSA Summary Inflation Report, October 2026
title: Summary Inflation Report, Consumer Price Index (2018=100), October 2026 (Philippine Statistics Authority, Reference No. 2026-351, released 5 November 2026)

sections.heading: Headline inflation
sections.text: Philippines headline inflation (2018=100): 1.7% in October 2025, 7.2% in September 2026, 7.8% in October 2026; year-to-date (January to October 2026) 5.6%. Core inflation: 5.4% in October 2026.
